source_doc: Genuin x iHeart - Monetize O&O, Audience Extension Framework

entities.name: Monetize
entities.description: Genuin's unified revenue product enabling onsite and offsite monetization through sponsorships, subscriptions, and ads across owned and network properties.

entities.name: Sponsored Placements Takeover
entities.description: Sponsored placement that takes over a homepage carousel with vertical video creative; supports MP4/MOV/AVI/WMV/MKV up to 2GB and can be sold to one or more advertisers.

entities.name: Pinned First Position Placement
aliases: Sponsored Community Podcast or Station First-In-Feed Takeover
entities.description: Sponsored first-in-feed pinned placement across communities, podcasts, or stations, live across 112+ stations and podcasts and configured via BCC.

entities.name: In-Feed Vertical Video Ad
entities.description: Programmatic vertical video ad served in-feed across desktop and mobile placements, activated through standard ad servers.

entities.name: Session Takeover
entities.description: Programmatic session takeover delivered via IAB-compatible tags (300x600, 300x250) on iHeart properties, opening new margin on existing programmatic deals.

entities.name: In-Stream Ad
entities.description: Programmatic in-stream video ad supporting pre-roll, mid-roll, and end-roll placements with on-click full view.

entities.name: Extended Placement In-Network
entities.description: Takeover sponsored placement extended onto Network partners' properties, allowing advertisers to control the audience-extension journey offsite.

entities.name: Extended Sponsored Placement In-Network
entities.description: Extends sponsored video placements onto Network partners' properties using brand assets such as logo, handle, video, description, and linkout.

entities.name: Programmatic Extended O&O
entities.description: Programmatic in-feed and in-stream ad placements extended onto Network partners' owned-and-operated properties via the brand's ad server.

entities.name: Programmatic Audience Extension
entities.description: IAB-compatible programmatic placements for audience extension across trusted Network partners using PMP, DealIDs, and unified auction.

entities.name: Subscription Plans
entities.description: Custom paid subscription access plans (e.g., $99/month) that grant partners contextual placement in Highlights and grow organic distribution; moderation managed by BCC.

entities.name: Highlights
entities.description: Sponsored content surface where partner posts appear in contextually relevant placements across onsite and offsite activation.

entities.name: Genuin Network
entities.description: Genuin's distribution network of trusted partner properties that supercharges campaigns and drives performance for advertisers and creators beyond walled gardens.

entities.name: Community Sponsorship Exclusive SOV
aliases: Sponsored Category Exclusive Share of Voice
entities.description: Exclusive share-of-voice sponsorship granting category, context, and community access with brand watermark and intro card on sponsored content.

entities.name: Earnings and Payouts
entities.description: Reporting and payout management surface within Monetize for tracking earnings and disbursing payouts.

entities.name: Relevance Analytics
entities.description: Earnings and relevance analytics used to guide partnership decisions within Monetize.

entities.name: Monetization Playbook
entities.description: Quick-start guide and playbook explaining why and how partners scale revenue with Monetize while maintaining experience control.

entities.name: Brand Watermark
entities.description: Brand watermark and intro card applied to sponsored category content to attribute and frame the sponsorship.

entities.name: BCC
entities.description: Configuration and moderation console used to set up brand-direct demand, manage Genuin posts, and curate subscription content.

entities.name: GAM
entities.description: Third-party ad server integration used to activate in-feed and in-stream programmatic placements.

entities.name: Anniview
entities.description: Third-party ad server integration supported for activating in-feed and in-stream placements.

entities.name: InfyTV
entities.description: Third-party ad server integration supported for activating in-feed and in-stream placements.

entities.name: IAB Standard Tags
entities.description: Industry-standard IAB ad tag formats (300x600, 300x250) used for session takeovers and audience extension.

entities.name: VAST
entities.description: Video Ad Serving Template standard used as the programmatic creative source for in-stream and session takeover placements.

entities.name: Ad Server
entities.description: Generic ad-server layer through which brand-direct programmatic demand is configured for extended O&O placements.

entities.name: Sponsorships
entities.description: Native, ongoing sponsorship revenue model offered via Monetize, replacing fragmented campaign-based sponsorships.

entities.name: Subscriptions
entities.description: Paid subscription revenue stream that gives partners contextual access to placements within Monetize.

entities.name: Ads
entities.description: Programmatic and direct advertising revenue stream consolidated within Monetize's monetization infrastructure.

entities.name: PMP
entities.description: Private marketplace deal model supported by programmatic audience extension for curated buyer access.

entities.name: DealIDs
entities.description: Deal-ID-based programmatic transaction mechanism used for audience-extension activations.

entities.name: Publishers
entities.description: Publishers who embed Genuin video community feeds to drive onsite engagement, sales, and media revenue.

entities.name: Retailers
entities.description: Retailers who use embedded Genuin video community feeds to drive onsite engagement and commerce.

entities.name: Brands and Advertisers
entities.description: Brand and advertiser audience that gains reach and distribution of video assets across engaged Network audiences.

entities.name: Consumers
entities.description: End consumers who get personalized feeds surfacing relevant content, offers, and social interaction.

entities.name: iHeartMedia
entities.description: Audio and media partner whose omnichannel properties host Monetize sponsored and programmatic placements such as homepage carousels, pinned first positions, and IAB tag takeovers.

entities.name: Network Partners
entities.description: Trusted third-party properties in the Genuin Network where sponsored and programmatic Monetize placements extend offsite.

entities.name: Extended Podcasters
entities.description: Podcaster partners outside the core network who can purchase subscription access to appear in Highlights placements.

entities.name: Station Partners
entities.description: Radio/station partners who can purchase subscription access to appear in Highlights placements alongside extended podcasters.
